factors.label: Flock Consensus
factors.desc: Flock Fantasy overall draft-sheet rank (1 = best). Medium prior (~25% in Balanced).

factors.label: Last Year Stats
factors.desc: Actual 2025 fantasy points in the selected scoring format

factors.label: Age
factors.desc: Player age in years. Model uses a position-specific peak-age fitness curve under the hood.

factors.label: Quarterback
factors.desc: Team QB quality (32 = best). Applies to WR & TE only. N/A for QB, RB, K, DST.

factors.label: Offensive Line
factors.desc: OL quality (32 = best run/pass blocking). Applies to RB & QB only. N/A for WR, TE, K, DST.

factors.label: Playcaller
factors.desc: OC/scheme (32 = best). Applies to QB/RB/WR/TE only — never K or DST.

factors.label: ADP
factors.desc: 2026 average draft position (1.0 = first pick). Lower ADP = higher draft capital.

factors.label: Vegas Lines
factors.desc: Per-player season props: QB pass yds/TDs, RB rush+rec yds/TDs, WR/TE rec yds/TDs (NOT team wins). Higher primary line = higher market expectation.

factors.label: Opportunity
factors.desc: Projected volume/role ranked within position (1 = best opportunity at the position)

factors.label: Efficiency
factors.desc: Efficiency rating 0–100 (YPT / TD rate / explosive-play quality)

factors.label: Health
factors.desc: Estimated games played durability (0–17). Higher = healthier profile.

factors.label: Strength of Schedule
factors.desc: Schedule ease among 32 teams (32 = easiest fantasy schedule, 1 = hardest)

weight_presets.label: Balanced
weight_presets.desc: Flock ~25% + even blend of production, role, situation, market.

weight_presets.label: Youth & Upside
weight_presets.desc: Age curve, opportunity, health — chase breakouts.

weight_presets.label: Beat the Market
weight_presets.desc: Flock + ADP + Vegas — lean into consensus boards.

model_notes: Natural units; weighted 0–100 percentiles. N/A env factors (QB only WR/TE; OL only RB/QB; playcaller never K/DST) are dropped and remaining weights renormalized.
sources: Playcaller / QB / OL ranks: model composite for 2026 (1–32 among 32 teams)
